newsitem.title: GREECE: Ecu/drachma, depos, forwards hold, CPI-bond hits mkt.
newsitem.headline: Ecu/drachma, depos, forwards hold, CPI-bond hits mkt.

text.p: Greek depos and forex forwards were trading narrowly holding Friday afternoon levels, ecu/drachma was steady to easier and bonds were little changed with five-and 10-year CPI-indexed bonds going on sale today, traders said.
"It is very quiet so far," said a dealer at a private bank. "Depos and forex forwards are holding late Friday levels."
Bond dealers said players were positioning themselves to buy fixed-coupon bonds and FRNs at slightly lower price levels but the market focus was on CPI-indexed bonds, dealers said.
Five and 10-year, 4.0 percent CPI-indexed bonds on Monday.
"It is the first time ever that Greece issues CPI-indexed bonds and it is hard to estimate how they will sell," said a bond dealer at a private bank. "A rough estimate is 100 billion drachmas."
Banks could buy some CPI-indexed bonds for their clients but they were not interested in the instruments tradewise, delaers said.
The mark was quoted at 159.44/49 from Friday's 159.495 fix, the dollar at 270.16/26 drachmas from 271.300 and the ecu at 311.12/22 from 311.440 drachmas.

"Ecu/drachma is easier trading above 311 level at 311.15/20," said a senior dealer at a private bank. "I think it will be difficult to see ecu/drachma above 312 in the near future with the central bank showing uneasiness with levels above 312."
The central bank intervened in two consecutive sessions, last Thursday and Friday, and sold dollars, ecus and marks for drachmas at the fixing, pushing ecu/drachma lower.
